CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_users_lookup_by_matricula(p_matricula text)
 RETURNS TABLE(nome text, sobrenome text, email text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select nome, sobrenome, email from public.app_users where matricula = p_matricula limit 1;
$function$
